# HR-Breaker

> HR-Breaker is a resume optimization SaaS that rewrites your resume to match any job posting, runs a real Applicant Tracking System (ATS) simulation, and returns an optimized, ATS-parsable PDF. It is built for job seekers who want to pass automated screening filters without fabricating experience.

## What it does

- Accepts resumes in PDF, LaTeX, Markdown, HTML, or plain text.
- Extracts the key requirements and keywords from a job posting URL or pasted description.
- Rewrites and reformats the resume to match the posting.
- Runs a built-in ATS simulation before returning the file.
- Performs hallucination detection to ensure no skills, roles, or credentials are fabricated — every claim in the output must be grounded in the uploaded source resume.
- Returns a single-column, ATS-parsable PDF.

## Pricing

- **Starter** — free to try, no credit card required.
- **Job Hunter** — paid tier for active job seekers; full feature set.
- **Offer Mode** — top tier including interview prep and cover letter generation.
- Add-on packs: €5 per extra 10 optimization requests.

## Product pages

- [Homepage](https://hrbreaker.co/): value proposition, how it works, feature list, pricing, FAQ.
- [Pricing](https://hrbreaker.co/pricing): plan comparison and add-on packs.

## FAQ highlights

- **Will the optimized resume contain false information?** No. Hallucination detection compares every claim in the output against the uploaded source and flags anything that was not present.
- **Which input formats are supported?** PDF, LaTeX, Markdown, HTML, and plain text.
- **What do I get back?** A single-column, ATS-parsable PDF, optimized for the specific job posting.
- **Do I need to create an account to try it?** No — the Starter tier is free and requires no credit card.
